compiled_state.title: MQ-5: rewrite sprint/check-ruleset-preflight.sh for the MQ model
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description: Drop the staged-* + check-staged-head two-tier assertions (would fail sprint Phase A under MQ); assert merge_queue enabled on main + Goal-1 backstops required on merge_group + review-sub-pr on the sub-PR ruleset. Ref: ADR; sprint G2.

comments.body: HOLISTIC-REVIEW FINDING I3 (opus audit, 2026-06-03): scope MQ-5 as DUAL-MODE / transition-tolerant, NOT a hard flip to MQ-only. check-ruleset-preflight.sh is set -euo pipefail and runs at sprint Phase A; it currently hard-asserts the staged-* sub-PR ruleset + check-staged-head + llm-review-on-main and exits 1 on any miss. A hard flip to MQ-only assertions would fail every sprint Phase A in the window between MQ-5 landing and MQ-6a provisioning the live queue (live state is still two-tier) — recreating exactly the wedge MQ-3 was re-scoped to avoid. Mirror tests/scripts/test-ruleset-design-invariants.sh: discriminate on presence of a live merge_queue rule on the MAIN ruleset, FAIL-CLOSED to two-tier. Then MQ-5 lands independently and safely under the still-active two-tier flow, and MQ-6 doesn't have to carry preflight changes.
comments.author: Test

comments.body: MQ-5 implemented + committed (a90ffd09b7) as DUAL-MODE per finding I3: check-ruleset-preflight.sh now discriminates on a live merge_queue rule on the MAIN ruleset (fail-closed to two-tier). MQ branch asserts merge_queue present + check-staged-head retired + llm-review required + no linear + some ruleset still requires the sub-PR check. 4 new behavioral gh-stub tests + existing two-tier tests pass (21/21); live preflight passes vs current two-tier (no deadlock). Landing via merge-to-main (PR #583 -> staged).
